candidates.term: The Twin inside the Year Gate
candidates.defline: The Twin lives inside your Year Gate: underneath your early years you learned to rely on yourself.
candidates.reading: Your first home expected you to manage, and you were trusted with your own problems before most children are. Because you were trusted young, you came to trust yourself before anyone else, and you worked out much of what you know without asking. The habit makes it hard for you to let people in, at home or anywhere, and you accept help only after you have tried it alone.
candidates.teaser: Some part of you grew up fast and private, learning to need very little. That toughness holds, though letting people in will always take deliberate effort.

domain_readings.Family: Your family root runs on quiet capability: a house where small people were treated as able ones, and you rose to it. As an adult you hold family the same way, present, level, unfussy. The tenderness is real underneath. Let it surface before occasions force it.
domain_readings.Growth: You grow from self-trust outward: every skill you own began with deciding you could. That root makes you nearly unteachable by force and endlessly teachable by choice. Choose teachers on purpose. Growth accelerates the moment you allow someone alongside.

candidates.life_chapter: Your early chapter built the keel: somewhere before the world was watching, you learned to hold your own, and it set the hull for everything after. The strengths of those hidden years surface all your life as steadiness others cannot explain. Expect to be the calm one in every storm.
candidates.relations: Siblings and the earliest household are this seat’s people: bonds forged level, loyalty without ceremony. Whoever stood beside you in the first chapters keeps a claim on you, and honoring it keeps you whole. Reach back sometimes. The root feeds both directions.
candidates.turn_catalyst: Run thin, the root holds but the trunk doubts: self-trust flickers at exactly the wrong moments. Practice one small self-kept promise weekly. The keel remembers.
candidates.turn_friction: Run heavy, the sturdiness seals: needing no one becomes knowing no one deeply. Let the oldest bond back in first.
candidates.shadow_line: Overloaded, the root refuses replanting: growth declined because it required asking.
candidates.health_line: Your constitution is quietly durable: it endures more than it should before signaling. Build the habit of early rest, because your body will never demand it.

Family.headline: You grew up level with the people around you.
Family.recognition: You treat your family as equals, present and practical and never fussy. Because closeness when you were small came from standing side by side, you show tenderness late and mostly through what you do. You turn up to fix a family problem before anyone asks, and you rarely say what you feel while you do it.
Family.lived: In your first home a sibling or a cousin stood beside you as an equal, and the two of you looked after each other. You learned to settle things between yourselves, and the adults were the last to hear about them.

Growth.headline: You grow from trusting yourself first.
Growth.recognition: Every skill you have began with deciding that you could do it. Because you learned early to depend on yourself, nobody can push you into learning, and you take to a teacher only once you have chosen them. You pick things up faster with one other person learning beside you, and you let few people that close.
Growth.lived: You taught yourself things as a child that the adults around you had not shown you, and you kept quiet about how hard it was. By the time you were grown you had a stubborn way of learning, on your own terms and at your own pace.

$provenance.replaced: This position rules Family and Growth, and it works from the root of your story. The Twin lives inside your Year Gate, the hidden face: somewhere early you became your own backup, in a house that treated small people as capable ones. The root took, and it still holds your weight. Growth for you starts from self-trust, and it always will. Family bonds run level, brothers and sisters in spirit if they were level too. The counsel is gentle: some help is worth accepting purely to stay in practice. Sturdiness that never leans eventually forgets how.
